title: GPT-Image-2.5 过去六小时 X 实测扫描增补
surface: Google Chrome · X Latest · public status media metadata
notes: 本增补来自同一 6 小时窗口内继续滚动的 X Latest 结果；每条记录保留原帖 URL、发布者、账号与正文摘录。
效果媒体的直出地址另存于 gpt-image-2-5-assets.json，仅用于前端直接展示；原帖地址仍是证据入口。
没有把“完整 prompt 在 thread 中”、截断或只描述效果的正文补写成可复制 prompt。
prompt 去重按清洗后的完整正文比对；同一条 prompt 只进入一次可复制区。

dedupe.promptRule: normalize whitespace, punctuation and case; keep one full-text entry per normalized prompt

comparison.baseline: GPT-Image-2：从一张结果继续改动时，主体、材质或背景容易逐轮漂移。
comparison.upgrade: GPT-Image-2.5：AGIラボ用同一机器人连续 9 次编辑，反馈称脸、质感与背景仍能保住；taziku 也把它用于保持形状与坐标的连续镜头。
comparison.evidence: 同帖对比 + 连续工作流实测

comparison.baseline: GPT-Image-2：透明底、产品资产和多轮迭代往往需要额外清理或人工修正。
comparison.upgrade: GPT-Image-2.5：AmotDesign 报告可一发生成透明 PNG；Adobe Firefly 以包装、文字和持续迭代展示 Sunburst / Flare 的生产取向。
comparison.evidence: 上手反馈 + 平台展示

comparison.baseline: GPT-Image-2：同时指定人物、服装、环境或产品参考时，角色分工容易混在一起。
comparison.upgrade: GPT-Image-2.5：YUNTJP 用吉他图、角色三视图和名字生成画面，并特别记录模型从图中读出“Suhr Modern”等细节。

comparison.baseline: GPT-Image-2：人物皮肤、发丝和背景容易出现明显的合成感。
comparison.upgrade: GPT-Image-2.5：K_polar_AI 反馈发丝、皮肤纹理放大后仍自然；Ankit 的长 prompt 则把头发、毛孔、眼睛、光线和生活场景作为完整约束。
comparison.evidence: 人像实测 + 完整 prompt

prompts.title: 生活方式人像
prompts.text:
Photorealistic 4:5 morning lifestyle photograph of the same young adult woman, preserving her recognizable facial features and overall appearance. She has long, naturally wavy auburn-red hair, realistic individual hair strands, natural skin texture, subtle pores, tiny imperfections, realistic eyes with natural catchlights, and a genuine relaxed smile while looking directly into the camera. She is wearing modest, comfortable cream-colored home loungewear with a soft cardigan and neutral lounge pants, making fresh coffee in a sleek modern kitchen.

Photography: professional cinematic smartphone photography, raw unretouched realism, natural morning sunlight, realistic skin tones, physically accurate shadows, subtle lens imperfections, authentic exposure, fine facial detail, natural depth of field, no beauty-filter effect, no plastic skin, no CGI appearance, no overly smooth face, no artificial eyes. Full head completely inside the frame with comfortable space above her hair, natural proportions, sharp facial focus.

Environment: large luxury-modern kitchen with warm wood cabinetry, marble countertops, stainless-steel appliances, espresso machine, coffee beans, ceramic mug, croissant, fresh berries, flowers, indoor plants, tasteful minimalist décor, pendant lighting, large windows with a bright morning city view. Natural candid atmosphere, elegant architectural composition, realistic household details, premium editorial lifestyle photography, cinematic but believable.
prompts.dedupeKey: photorealistic 4 5 morning lifestyle photograph of the same young adult woman preserving her recognizable facial features and overall appearance she has long naturally wavy auburn red hair realistic individual hair strands natural skin texture subtle pores tiny imperfections realistic eyes with natural catchlights and a genuine relaxed smile while looking directly into the camera
prompts.captureNote: 原帖正文完整可见；保留原始分段与英文措辞，适合直接复制测试。
